title: CPF Module Schema: __MSSQL Failover Group__ module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-mssqlfailovergroup'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 10 chars).

databases.description: (Optional) A set of database names to include in the failover group.

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

partner_server.description: (Required) A partner_server block as defined below.

read_write_endpoint_failover_policy.description: (Required) A read_write_endpoint_failover_policy block as defined below. mode = "(Required) The failover policy of the read-write endpoint for the failover group. Possible values are Automatic or Manual."Automatic"" grace_minutes = "(Optional) The grace period in minutes, before failover with data loss is attempted for the read-write endpoint. Required when mode is Automatic."

readonly_endpoint_failover_policy_enable.description: (Optional) Whether failover is enabled for the readonly endpoint

server_id.description: (Required) The ID of the primary SQL Server on which to create the failover group. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

id.description: The Resource ID of the azure mssql failover group

name.description: The Name of the azure mssql failover group

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Mssqlfailovergroup' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
